verdict.rationale: SES documents notifications for bounced, complained, and delivered emails through Amazon SNS. It also documents event publishing to SNS, EventBridge, Firehose, and CloudWatch through configuration sets. However, no direct HTTP webhook appears in the evidence: you must route events through another AWS service to reach your app. Missing for 10: native HTTP webhook delivery to an app endpoint, documented retry/redelivery behavior, and hands-on corroboration of real-time event handling.
